Trigger Condition: Exception case(s) created from an ATR-upload hand-off (per observation)
Email Purpose: New exception cases assigned to you for review
CTA / Deep-link: Open case list filtered to the new cases

Trigger Condition: Case created from a query / bulk import
Email Purpose: New exceptions require classification

Trigger Condition: Case created but no owner assigned
Email Purpose: Unassigned exceptions need an owner

Trigger Condition: RO classifies a case (any disposition) -> awaiting auditor
Email Purpose: A classification is ready for your review

Trigger Condition: Case left Unclassified past its SLA
Email Purpose: Exception still needs classification

Trigger Condition: AU approves a non-actionable classification (BAU / False Positive) -> case Closed
Email Purpose: Exception closed - no action plan needed

Trigger Condition: AU approves an actionable classification -> action plan now required
Email Purpose: Classification approved - please submit an action plan

Trigger Condition: AU rejects the classification -> reopens for re-classification
Email Purpose: Classification rejected - please re-classify

Trigger Condition: RO submits a management action plan + due date
Email Purpose: An action plan is ready for your review

Trigger Condition: AU approves the plan -> RO to implement
Email Purpose: Action plan approved - implementation can begin

Trigger Condition: AU rejects the plan (discrepancy) -> reopens at RO
Email Purpose: Action plan rejected - see auditor comments

Trigger Condition: RO marks the action complete (action taken + evidence)
Email Purpose: An action is ready for completion review

Trigger Condition: AU verifies Implemented -> case Closed
Email Purpose: Exception verified and closed

Trigger Condition: AU marks Partially Implemented -> back to RO (In-Progress)
Email Purpose: Action partially accepted - further work needed

Trigger Condition: AU rejects (Discrepancy) -> case reopens at RO
Email Purpose: Action rejected - discrepancy found, please redo

Trigger Condition: RO requests a due-date revision
Email Purpose: A due-date extension needs your approval

Trigger Condition: AU approves the revision
Email Purpose: Due-date extension approved - new date set

Trigger Condition: AU rejects the revision
Email Purpose: Due-date extension rejected - original date stands

Trigger Condition: Action due date approaching (e.g. T-3 / T-1 day)
Email Purpose: Action due soon

Trigger Condition: Action due date passed -> Overdue
Email Purpose: Exception is overdue and needs attention

Trigger Condition: Assigner assigns a case (single or bulk) to a team member
Email Purpose: A case has been assigned to you

Trigger Condition: Assignment replaces an existing owner (re-assignment)
Email Purpose: A case was reassigned away from you

Trigger Condition: Assignee submits drafted work -> enters approval at L1
Email Purpose: An item is awaiting your approval

Trigger Condition: Level approved but more approvers remain (parallel all)
Email Purpose: Your approval is still needed

Trigger Condition: Level fully approved -> advances to next level
Email Purpose: An item has advanced to your level for approval

Trigger Condition: Sequential mode - it is the next approver's turn
Email Purpose: It is your turn to approve

Trigger Condition: Final level approved -> case advances to next platform stage
Email Purpose: Approved - case finalized and advanced

Trigger Condition: An approver rejects -> returns to assignee
Email Purpose: Your submission was rejected - see comments

Trigger Condition: Approver sends back to the previous level
Email Purpose: An item was sent back to your level

Trigger Condition: Send-back at L1 -> bounced to assignee to revise
Email Purpose: Revisions requested before approval

Trigger Condition: Send-back limit (3) reached -> escalated to assigner
Email Purpose: Approval loop escalated - your decision needed

Trigger Condition: Assigner recalls an in-flight assignment
Email Purpose: An assignment was recalled by the assigner

Trigger Condition: Assignee deactivated mid-flight -> needs reassignment
Email Purpose: An assignee is inactive - case needs reassignment

Trigger Condition: Current level SLA at-risk (<=25% time left)
Email Purpose: Approval due soon

Trigger Condition: Current level SLA overdue
Email Purpose: Approval is overdue

Email Purpose: New comment on an exception you are working

Trigger Condition: Comment posted with an attachment
Email Purpose: New comment with an attachment

Trigger Condition: Bulk comment posted across multiple cases
Email Purpose: New comments across N exceptions

Trigger Condition: Bulk classify / review / complete applied to a group
Email Purpose: Bulk action applied - items need your attention

Trigger Condition: Case reaches Closed (any path)
Email Purpose: Exception closed

Trigger Condition: Case reopens (rejection / discrepancy)
Email Purpose: An exception was reopened and needs rework

Trigger Condition: End-of-day open workload summary
